title: UI addon
description: addon.yaml of a UI addon (docs/modding/interfaces.md): a whole UI that shows the game's screens its own way, or a plugin that adds documents over the UI that is on. The game pack's ui/addon.yaml describes the default UI.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; the addon's folder name.

version.description: The addon's own version, shown next to its name.

ui_api.description: The UI API versions it works with: one version (0.8: that one and the later ones of its major) or bounds (>=0.8 <0.12).

type.description: ui: shows screens; plugin: adds documents.

screens.description: A ui addon: the document (an asset id without the extension, relative to the addon's folder) that shows each screen it covers. The rest keep the default UI's.

documents.description: A plugin: the documents it adds over the UI, relative to its folder.
